expect_red: an element whose part has no installed mesh filters the parts panel to nothing AND says why

mutations.contract: A rail scoped to one element scopes BOTH its panels. The parts panel was the half that was filtered by nothing at all.
mutations.note: cmdTrace/cmdGoto already scoped the ELEMENT list to a study before this handoff; renderPartsPanel walked state.meshList regardless, so entering the flyout from one element still listed every installed mesh in the repo beside it. The mutation is that exact previous line. There is no shim tier for this app (ES module, three.js, a WebGL context), so the browser tier is the only place it can be witnessed. The declared check is the no-installed-mesh one (1 part -> 0) and not the obvious 'filtered to one part', because the mock fixture installs exactly ONE mesh: filtered-to-1 and unfiltered-1 are the same number, so that check cannot discriminate. The suite says so at the call site.
